content: Go net package sets SO_BROADCAST=1 by default on every SOCK_DGRAM/SOCK_RAW socket on all platforms (verified in Go 1.27 GOROOT source: net/sockopt_linux.go, sockopt_bsd.go, sockopt_windows.go - Allow broadcast comment). net.ListenUDP sockets are unconnected: use WriteToUDP for broadcast+unicast from one socket; own-broadcast echo arrives back on the same socket and must be filtered by NodeID (design already handles this).
